verdict.rationale: Assigning a custom identifier to a served model is a fair question for a local model server, so the axis applies. Nothing in the evidence pack documents aliasing, copying, renaming, or naming a loaded model for API reference. The REST API, model hotswapping, and concurrent-model mentions are adjacent features and earn no credit.

support.subject: As a developer, I can assign a custom identifier to a loaded model for consistent reference in API calls
